dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Five prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are visible on the dorsal mid-section, characterized by high-contrast light perimeters surrounding dark centers with sharp gradient transitions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, solid light-intensity pixel clusters without internal gradients is observed along the lateral margins and the posterior region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest macro-annuli on the left dorsal flank form an obtuse triangle, while a cluster of three blobs on the lower right forms a near-equilateral triangle.

other_distinctive_markers: A reticulated mesh-like configuration is present in the central dorsal area where the boundaries of several macro-annuli intersect.
